Todd County in south central South Dakota...

or 13 miles southwest of Mission, moving east at 30 mph.

roofs, siding, and trees.

Mission, Rosebud, Saint Francis, Okreek, Antelope, Hidden Timber,
Sicangu Village, Lakeview, Littleburg, Fairgrounds Housing, Ring
Thunder, Two Strike, Soldier Creek, Haystack Butte and Rosebud
Reservation.

burning is not recommended.
